headline: Gold up slightly today, still well below last month; silver flat at ₹1,75,000 per kg
summary: Gold rose about 1% today, with 24K at ₹12,780 per gram (up ₹124) and 22K at ₹11,715 (up ₹115), while silver was unchanged at ₹1,75,000 per kg. Over the past week gold fell about 6% and silver about 8%, and over the 30 days in our history both are down more than 10% (silver about 20%); silver's ₹1,75,000 is the lowest in this period. Likely drivers include movements in the US dollar and rupee and global spot prices, though the spot data here is unchanged since today's rate was set.
outlook: Today's rise is small and prices are still well down on the past week, so there is no urgency either way; if you are buying for a wedding or festival, consider spreading purchases rather than timing one day.
